title: Spike Report
description: The outcome of a throwaway experiment that checks whether a tool, library or approach works. It records what was observed and what was not verified. It carries no gate and is not evidence that production code is correct.

question.description: The one question the spike answers, for example whether a library renders in the target stack

approach.description: The smallest experiment that could answer it

environment.description: Versions, host and stack the experiment ran in

scratch_path.description: Where the throwaway code lives. It is discarded or rebuilt through a planned implementation, never extended in place.

observed.description: What actually happened, including output and errors

verified.description: What the experiment demonstrated, each backed by something observed

unverified.description: What the experiment did not check: other platforms, scale, accessibility, edge cases

conclusion.description: The answer to the question. works needs at least one verified item.

followups.description: What to do next, for example promote to a requirement or discard

fidelity.description: Marks the artifact as a non-binding spike
